title: Mixed Event — Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back
meta.Outline: It's almost time for the Miya Girls choir recital. Honami is selected as the coordinator for her class, but it's hard to coordinate when everyone's opinions are split right down the middle! What is kindness? Stuck between a rock and a hard place, Honami gives her answer...!

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're going to practice together after school today, so I need to remember to bring the sheet music!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's always so strict with us...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But now that we're finally starting to play more like a band, I have to do my part and practice hard too!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hooona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep! Saki?!
You startled me...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, didn't I tell you to stop throwing yourself at other people like that? You might end up hurting them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Hona's so soft and huggable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's not a good reason at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm soft... Oh no...
Did I go overboard with apple pies?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami. For today's practice, I need to check something for the part I couldn't get right the other day. Can you help?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah! The part Shiho was telling us about?
I wanna practice that part too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And hopefully, Shiho will finally commend us today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's all work toward that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And also, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, how are things with your classmates lately...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thanks, Ichika...
For being concerned about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Everything is fine.
We're getting along great.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But let us know if anything happens again, okay? We'll set things straight for you again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you. Both of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, we should head back to class soon.
See you again after school, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, there she is!
Honami, are you free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After school?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: We're planning to go get some pancakes together. You wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for inviting me, but I can't, sorry. I already have something I need to do after school today, so I won't be able to join you.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Where are you going after school?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have band practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh yeah! That's right!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Well, there's always next time.
Good luck with practice, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I really have to thank Ichika and the others for how honest I can be with my classmates now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank you, everyone.)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait... Are Miku and Luka not here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right. That's unusual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're probably around here somewhere, right? The last time this happened, we bumped into Luka on the rooftop, remember?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyways, shall we get ready then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're gonna nail those songs today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so eager to go, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She's been doing really well recently too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And the choir recital is soon too, right?
That's been fueling her enthusiasm as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The choir recital...
Right. I'd forgotten all about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's one set piece and one of our choice, if I remember correctly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Sounds like a pain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! It's not a pain! It's gonna be so much fun to sing together with all our classmates!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which means less time for band practice, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, well... Yes, but you know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure we all have our own views of the event... But instead of discussing this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I wonder where Miku and Luka are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little worried. Could something have happened?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm... Why don't we go look for them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Maybe they're just hanging out in another classroom. Let's go look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heeey! Miku! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're not inside this one either...
Could something actually have happened?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Is that... Someone playing the drums?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's coming from the classroom in the corner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe Miku and Luka are playing there. Let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's this classroom, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello? Miku? Luka?
Huh?
Hey girls, nice of you to drop by. Welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Except that probably sounds a little strange considering I'm the newcomer here.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you the people whose feelings created this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No way... You're...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yup, I'm MEIKO.
Nice to meet you all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! Seriously?!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: MEIKO's here... But how?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We never saw her here before...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Everyone's here...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Were you looking for us by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku! Luka!
Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry about worrying you. MEIKO showed up, so we were giving her a tour of the place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then we sensed that you'd all come and brought her here to surprise you, but we must've passed each other along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO just showing up when she was never around before... What does this mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's probably connected to everyone's true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our true feelings? Of always wanting to be together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're here in SEKAI to help you find those feelings, but I suppose things are a little bit different in my case.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that I'm here because you all managed to move forward after finding your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I'm just guessing though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, I'm here and hope you won't mind me sticking around.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Of course not! It'd be great to have you with us...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As usual, I don't get this place...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait. Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO's joining us for our practice sessions from now on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're Ichika, you're Saki and Shiho... And Honami, right? I'm looking forward to playing with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is such a pleasant surprise...
I can't believe I'm actually talking to MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're happy to have you with us, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, now that you've met everyone, why don't we play something together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good idea. I was just about to suggest the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... We heard someone playing the drums just now, so does that mean you're a drummer, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I play a few other instruments too.
You're the drummer of the band, right, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes! If you don't mind, could I ask you for some tips later?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! I'm always happy to help!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku...
Before that, I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before we all start playing together, would it be okay if we watched the three of you play first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm just kind of curious, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too. I'd like to see how the three of you play together as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If that's the case, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about me on guitar, Luka on bass and MEIKO on drums?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay with me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's begin!
One, two, three, four!
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't this... Our song?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is amazing! This doesn't sound like the Miku and Luka we usually hear...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it sounds so much cooler than when we play!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's completely different. It's better than when Miku and Luka are alone, or when we play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think it's because of MEIKO's drumming.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The drum is the foundation that supports the band. It has the power to draw out the entire band's potential.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks to MEIKO's drumming, Miku and Luka are able to go all out and play to their heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The foundation that supports the band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (MEIKO's so cool. She looks so strong and confident...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder if I'll ever be able to play like that one day?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Class, it's time we started preparing for the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We have to sing two songs, one that will be given to us and another of your choice. During today's homeroom, let's try to decide which song we should sing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh! I completely forgot about the recital because of MEIKO. We're supposed to start preparing for it today?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho said it'd be a pain, but I'm actually looking forward to singing with everyone in the class.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The choir recital...!
Oh boy!! I can't wait!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we can put a smile on everyone's faces like for the Sports Festival! Let's have fun and sing our way to gold!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Otori, I know you're all fired up, but try to stay in your seat, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwaagh! I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I agree with her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival helped the class to get along, so hopefully that will help us pull off a good recital.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To help things go smoothly, I'd like to appoint a coordinator for the recital who isn't the class representative.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, would you be up to the task?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
Wh-Who, me?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, you. I believe you have what it takes to handle this. So what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not sure if I can...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have band practice too, and what if I end up dragging the entire class down instead?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I want to try...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'll give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Good. I'll leave today's homeroom session up to you then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thanks to everyone, I can be more honest about my feelings with my classmates so...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I want to do what I can to make the recital fun for all of them!)
After school - Homeroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, for today's homeroom, we'll be selecting a song to sing for the competition and planning out a practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's start with the song.
Does anyone have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me, me, me!
Let's do "Smile Tomorrow Too"!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a happy and cheerful song that's bound to put a smile on everyone's face♪

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I vote for Otori's choice too! It'll be a bit hard to learn, but the challenge will be worth it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Plus, that was the song that won gold last year, right? We might as well aim for that too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. Does anyone else have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yes. How about "The Voice of Time"?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We sang it in music class, so we won't have to practice too much for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Why don't you wanna practice?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I have to go to cram school and can't let practice sessions interfere with that.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh... My after school club has a tournament coming up, so I won't be able to make it to every practice...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I have work after school so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: See? Everyone has stuff going on in their lives, so we should just go for something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I see...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: But can't you see we're trying to drum up some enthusiasm here? Keep your downer excuses to yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You can't just expect everyone to drop everything because you want them to. Talk about selfish.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wh-What did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Waaaah!
Please don't fight...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all get along like we did during the Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You can train on your own for some sports, but everyone has to be together for something like this. Can't you see it's not the same?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah... I don't want to spend too much time on this.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I just think we should at least try to do it properly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh dear... Everyone's opinions are split and I don't think either side is willing to compromise.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Emu was trying so hard to get everyone to agree, too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm supposed to be managing this.
I have to do something...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, let's vote on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone should be fine with following what the majority of the class wants, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure... Why not?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: And it's probably the only way we can decide anything right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. This should settle the matter...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, let's vote.
Raise your hands for...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: 16? The same amount for both sides?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What? I thought we had 33 people in this class?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you didn't include yourself, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uhm...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Mochizuki hasn't voted yet.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Man, this is a real drag.
Hey, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Since you're in charge, why don't you decide?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're the only one who hasn't voted yet.
You can decide which song we'll sing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the bell just rang...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry, but I'm afraid we'll have to continue this discussion during next week's homeroom session.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Sigh... This should've been the easiest part.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I don't care which song we sing. Just pick something, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A tough song will be too much of an inconvenience for some, but a simple one will disappoint those who want a challenge...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What should I do...?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to decide what to do by homeroom next week, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu!
I'm fine, but it's just...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You'd prefer to go all out for the recital, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I want to practice lots together and put a smile on the face of everyone listening!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But if everyone is busy, I guess a simpler song is better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As much as I want us to give it our best, I don't want everyone to start fighting with each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I definitely agree with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is such a heavy responsibility... But I agreed to do it, so I should think hard about what can be done to keep everyone happy...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I don't like seeing you look so stressed either...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I LOOOVE it when you smile, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I don't want you to seem so troubled like you did during homeroom...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So let me know if there's anything I can do to help! Anything at all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Emu...
I may just take you up on that offer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So your class couldn't decide about the recital?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Opinions were split right down the middle, too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's such a tough spot to be in...
What are you gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand the feelings of both the people who want to do their best and those who don't have the time to practice much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then how about a song that's just a little difficult? Does that work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... So does that make it an easy or difficult song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Hm... I dunno?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That would just make both sides unhappy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? You think so?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it's not fair to make you decide just because everyone else couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyone would be torn after hearing what you heard today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nngh!
Hona, your face is all droopy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't do that! A gloomy face scares off good ideas! Why don't we all go get some apple pies together later?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I'll pass.
I'm not that hungry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried because you're afraid, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're afraid of being disliked by the people on whichever side you don't pick, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, hang on a minute, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe that deciding to do something means you're choosing to give up on something else at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you have to be ready to accept that people will dislike you for your decisions. That's normal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Just do what you think is right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we should head over to practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Thanks for listening...
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... We sure practiced lots today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nicely done, everyone. It's getting pretty late, so we should probably stop here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let's pack up and go home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I'd like to practice a bit more before I leave.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like I didn't do very well today...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! Everything is fine. I'll be over in the classroom next door so I can concentrate better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll see you tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is terrible... I can't concentrate at all...

Knock knock!
Mind if I interrupt for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your drumming's not as sharp as it was before.
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were nice enough to help us with practice, but I guess I was a bit distracted.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You have nothing to apologize for.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you do seem very troubled about something. I was a bit worried, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Troubled...
Yes, I suppose you could say that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm always like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Worried that someone won't like me...
I haven't changed at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No wonder Shiho is so fed up with me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I'm sure she just wanted you to focus on practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But to be honest, fretting over something isn't always a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You only fret over something if you're trying to make it better than it is now, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And anyone trying their best to move forward is doing something good in my eyes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you like to tell me what's going on? I might be late to the party, but I'm still kind of your senpai, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see, so you were fretting about something that happened in class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I still don't know what to do.
I asked Ichika, Shiho and Saki too but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, you girls really are close.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. They've given me a lot of support...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was really trying to think things through with me. Saki saw that I was feeling down and wanted to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho said some harsh things too, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, did she?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She said I'm fretting so much because I didn't want to do anything that would make people dislike me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So you're afraid that people might dislike you for making a decision? May I ask why?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I was in junior high, my classmates would come to me for advice or just rant a little.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At first, I would just listen, thinking they probably just wanted to let off some steam.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But because of that, they started questioning me, asking me whose side I was on and accusing me of being two-faced. Soon, I was an outcast.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though it stopped when I entered high school, the fear of that happening again is still there and sort of haunts me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought I overcame that with everyone's help, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It seems like when you try to be on everyone's side, you end up on no one's...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Which is why Shiho is right.
I haven't changed at all since then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wonder if that's really true...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're doing your best to work out what's best for your classmates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're doing what you can to change too, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But at this rate...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I don't think there's anything wrong with remaining the kind sort of person you are now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But sometimes, you need the courage to become even kinder. And I'm sure you'll find that courage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Courage...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think it means to be kind, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Being kind?
Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyone would be torn after hearing what you heard today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't do that! A gloomy face scares off good ideas! Why don't we all go get some apple pies together later?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It means understanding how someone else feels or making them smile when they're feeling down.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried because you're afraid, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Just do what you think is right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Be candid with them for their own good...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds about right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are many different ways of expressing kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can empathize with someone who's troubled about something, make them smile or be somewhat direct.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As long as it was done with that person's best interests at heart, no matter what form it takes, it's a form of kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's also important to consider how the other person will take it too, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Different ways of expressing kindness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How do you want to present your kindness to your classmates?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The best way to express my kindness right now is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, that's a much better expression for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Somewhere inside, I've always thought that respecting others' preferences was the only thing I needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To me, as long as I always went along with what they wanted and made them feel happy, that was kindness.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that means I haven't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I'm going to think about it again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About the best way to express my kindness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, good.
I know you'll find the answer.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, how about we switch gears and get some drum practice in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!
The next morning
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The best way to express my kindness right now is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know if this will actually work but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I want to keep moving forward!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Morning!
The weather's so wonderhoy today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! You look so cheerful today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I think I figured out what I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this will actually solve things but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been thinking about what I can do to help everyone in class enjoy the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, so is there anything I can do to help at all?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? You want to help?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure I do! I'm happiest when everyone has a bright smile on their face after all☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. I'd feel a lot better with you helping out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...here's something you can help with. I'd like you to do a survey of the class.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure thing! You can count on me☆
After school

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Okay, Emu helped collect all the surveys...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now, we just have to decide on our song...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But sometimes, you need the courage to become even kinder. And I'm sure you'll find that courage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think it means to be kind, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was awesome, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That felt a lot better than usual.
I was really able to sing like I meant it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. And you're starting to sound like her too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like MEIKO's drumming, that is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The drum is the foundation that supports the band. It has the power to draw out the entire band's potential.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks to MEIKO's drumming, Miku and Luka are able to go all out and play to their heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this about the drummer being the foundation of the band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No wonder! That means Hona's drumming let us play our parts to the fullest too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Your sense of rhythm needs work.
And you're still not at MEIKO's level...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you've gotten a lot better than before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe it's because I felt so much better after speaking with all of you the other day about what happened in my class.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you think your class will be all good for the recital now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know yet, but all of my preparations are in place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We just need to decide on a song now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that won't be a problem...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Honestly... I'm a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's something I have to decide on, so I'm going to do everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry, Hona! I mean, you have us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No matter what happens, we're here for you. We know how much effort you're putting in for the class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Got it! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like she's fine now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think so too...
But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What is it, Miku? Are you pouting?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: N-No, I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure it's because you helped Honami before she could.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku was thinking long and hard yesterday about what to say to Honami so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but that doesn't mean I was pouting about it! I'm just glad to see that Honami's okay now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guess, I just wanted to help her like someone in my position should that's all...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You're already a good role model, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone here really is as kind as can be.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll start our discussion regarding the choir recital now.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What's the point in discussing things when some people lack any motivation anyways?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How about we vote again? I'm sure most of us just want to get this over with already.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, just pick something already...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no... This is getting bad...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone, please settle down.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to say something before we begin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no, my voice is starting to shake...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm so scared... I can't stop thinking about how everyone will turn on me after this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm confident that this is the best thing I can do for everyone right now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want you all to take part in the way that's best for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I also know it's not going to be easy to make everyone happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because what's personally important to you may not be that important to someone else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The more we talk, the more arguments there will be. Some may be left unhappy and frustrated.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I still hope that we can discuss this seriously and find a way to participate in the recital that will personally satisfy each of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like you all to listen to those who may not share your views and think about what you can say and do to accommodate them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll be doing everything to help this process along.
So please, give me your support too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope I've gotten through to them...!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Well, if you say it like that, I guess compromising isn't out of the question.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I agree with Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna see all of you with big smiles on your faces♪ So let's talk about how to make this fun for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I do want us all to have fun too.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: And we shouldn't sour the mood in class just over a song.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, if we're gonna do this, I'd rather do it properly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So let's all think about what song to pick again!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: But a difficult song definitely means we'll have to spend more time practicing, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I asked our music teacher about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They said that our class already has some good singers, so if we appoint them as section leaders, we'll be able to practice more efficiently.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Ah, okay. And that should shorten the time we need for practice.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: How about we record our practice sessions so everyone can listen to them?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: What about those who are too busy to go to every practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should be fine in terms of practice time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu helped me find out when everyone in class is free after school and it looks like we can put together a suitable schedule.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh, so that's what that survey was for...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I don't know though... Is everyone really gonna be able to stick to that schedule?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It will be hard for some to come to practice every day, which is why I want to make it okay to go just a few times each week.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Okay... That doesn't seem so bad then.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wowowee, Honami!
You're sooo clever!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not at all. It's not like I came up with this all by myself either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's because I opened up to everyone about this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a little difficult, but let's go with Smile Tomorrow Too as our song. And I'll be adjusting the practice schedule for everyone, if that's okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: And... I'm sorry for accusing you of not being motivated. I know cram school's really tough too...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: And I'm sorry too for being such a wet blanket. I was frustrated because my grades slipped a little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
This is awesome, isn't it, Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It is...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but I know we can do this together!
A few weeks later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The choir recital was so much fun, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! Everyone was so enthusiastic! I had a great time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I wish I could've heard everyone sing too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So who ended up winning?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My class got bronze.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were so close! We all practiced so hard too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The most important thing is that you enjoyed yourself, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Regardless of the outcome, you should cherish such wonderful memories.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: True! The best reward was all the fun we had!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm still not a big fan of events like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you did your best anyway, so we're proud of you too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just didn't want to be the one to drag everyone else down.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But every class sang so well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, Honami's class was in a league of its own...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! They even beat the third year students to win gold! The whole place was in an uproar when they announced the winners!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The teachers couldn't stop praising them either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you... But it's because everyone put so much effort into it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it's also because of all of you too that my class worked up the enthusiasm to go for the gold.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Talking to all of you gave me the courage I needed to speak up and tell my classmates how I really felt.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So... Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad it worked out, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shall we start our own practice now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, I was practicing the part you told me about the other day at home. Can you take a listen before we start?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about we go grab our instruments too?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just wanted to say thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You helped me muster up the courage to move forward. So if there's anything I can do to repay you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You found the answer and moved forward all by yourself, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But without the push you gave me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, in that case...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about we practice drumming together again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you want to practice together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I don't always get to practice with somebody else. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'd be happy to!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
MEIKO! Hona!
We're about to start!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shall we, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!!
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good morning. I'm good to start.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, can you take care of the setup?
And the flyers too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Got it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's a lot of people here today.
I wonder who's performing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hm... "STANDOUT", huh? They've always been good, but they've been attracting more fans lately too.)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Did you hear that STANDOUT's debuting with a major label soon?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Seriously?! But I'm not surprised.
They've been so awesome lately...!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Oh, but I heard they're swapping out one of the members before making their debut.

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Then it must be the bassist.
She's just been coasting for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(A major label, huh?
Maybe someday, I...)

Hey. You're Hinomori, one of the staff here, right?
I've seen you sub as a bassist a few times.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: My name is Iori, the vocalist for STANDOUT. Sorry if this is out of the blue, but I wanted you to know that I love your sound.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And... Would you like to join my band?
